description: This file contains a test class `LoadSheddingTest` that tests load shedding functionalities in an Orleans-based application, specifically handling overloaded gateway scenarios. It configures a test cluster, manipulates environment statistics to simulate overload conditions, and verifies the system's response to overloads via unit tests.

classes.name: LoadSheddingTest
classes.description: A unit test class that verifies load shedding behaviors under overloaded conditions in an Orleans cluster. Implements setup for test fixtures, methods to simulate overload via environment statistics, and test cases to validate the system's response.

methods.name: LoadSheddingBasic
methods.description: Tests that a message is rejected with a GatewayTooBusyException when the system is overloaded.

methods.name: LoadSheddingComplex
methods.description: Tests the behavior of load shedding: during overload, messages are shed; once overload is removed, messages are processed successfully.

methods.name: LatchIsOverloaded
methods.description: Simulates an overload condition by adjusting environment statistics to above threshold CPU usage and forces system refresh.

methods.name: UnlatchIsOverloaded
methods.description: Removes overload condition and forces system to refresh its overload state.
